title: Collin Thoman
description: Collin Thoman - IT Service Management Leader

about.heading: About
about.text1: I build and lead IT teams that deliver real business value. Over 12+ years I've grown from hands-on engineering into management, always staying close enough to the technical work to make informed decisions and mentor effectively. My approach blends ITIL discipline with agile flexibility — I care about service quality, security posture, and creating environments where people do their best work.
about.text2: Currently learning Dutch and exploring IT leadership opportunities in the Netherlands/Belgium and Seattle regions. With established connections in the Benelux area and a strong commitment to cultural integration, I'm prepared for a transition to the EMEA market.

jobs.title: Information Technology Manager
jobs.summary: Led a team of six across help desk, systems, and security functions for a 186-person law firm. Owned the service delivery lifecycle, security program, and $2.5M annual IT budget while partnering with leadership to align technology investments with firm strategy.
accomplishments: Built ITIL-aligned service catalog, SLA framework, and change management processes that measurably improved deployment success rates
Deployed multi-layer security stack (CrowdStrike EDR, Rapid7 SIEM, Mimecast, Cisco Meraki) enabling the firm to pass client security audits and unlock new revenue
Launched satisfaction surveys in Jira Service Management — achieved 4.8/5 rating and improved response times by 25%
Developed training programs and a knowledge repository for the IT team, supporting succession planning and professional growth
Managed vendor relationships, contract negotiations, and technology procurement, driving cost savings on renewals

jobs.title: System Administrator
jobs.summary: Managed enterprise infrastructure through rapid growth (140 to 186 users) and the firm's emergency COVID-19 remote transition. Performance in this role led to the creation of the IT Manager position.
accomplishments: Led unified communications migration from on-prem Cisco to Zoom Phone/Meetings/Chat, achieving 100% adoption through hands-on training and change management
Replaced legacy VPN and DNS security (Pulse Secure, Cisco Umbrella) with Cloudflare Zero Trust, modernizing remote access
Migrated from Zendesk to Jira Service Management & Confluence with ITIL-aligned knowledge bases, cutting average resolution time by 10-15 minutes
Architected hybrid cloud environment (AWS EC2/VPC + Azure) with site-to-site VPN and redundant domain controllers for BCP/DR
Consolidated server footprint from 110 to 80 through strategic optimization, reducing operational costs
Spearheaded emergency transition to 100% remote work for 186 employees during COVID-19, leveraging pre-pandemic hardware standardization

jobs.title: IT Support Engineer
jobs.summary: Delivered managed IT services and consulting across multiple client organizations. Served as the primary on-site engineer and trusted IT advisor, handling everything from Windows Server and SharePoint administration to MDM deployments and automation scripting.
accomplishments: Built documentation and knowledge management systems that enabled team scalability across client engagements
Created automation scripts for software deployments, reducing deployment time and manual errors

jobs.title: IT Field Engineer / Event Manager
jobs.summary: Started in residential and SMB IT support, then advanced to managing regional technology education events. Recruited and led teams of 20-35 temporary staff for events serving up to 200 youth participants, and built partnerships with non-profit organizations across the region.
